name: herbalist_n_walk_v01
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: hand-painted NONPIXEL miniature NPC four-frame animation. Input image is the EXACT canonical single neutral model, not a suggestion. Keep the same compact 2.7-head proportions and SAME skull size, face angle, crown, shoulders, torso, pelvis and costume. Long deep teal-blue hair in a low flowing ponytail, soft bangs, amber-honey eyes, small ivory flower-and-green-leaf cluster with muted brick-red ribbon by anatomical LEFT ear, human round ears. Ochre/mustard-gold draped shawl/cape with pale botanical border and fine fringes, muted plum-brown fitted overdress over ivory ruffled layered skirt and ivory puff-sleeve blouse, thin brown waist cord with small tassels, brown floral lace-up boots. ONE small wicker herb basket held low in LEFT hand containing green leaves and white blossoms, right hand relaxed. Keep the original shawl draping/long ponytail silhouette and warm gold/plum/ivory palette; no wizard hat or staff. Camera locked to straight BACK, looking away upward; never turn head/body. Draw one slow in-place WALK CYCLE, four DISTINCT chronological poses in 2x2 reading order. Frame1 anatomical RIGHT leg (screen RIGHT) strides away/up, LEFT leg trails down. Frame2 RIGHT planted under pelvis while LEFT knee swings away. Frame3 LEFT leg (screen LEFT) strides away/up and RIGHT trails down with sole visible. Frame4 LEFT planted and RIGHT knee swings away. Alternate screen-left and screen-right trailing boot. Keep upper body upright, pelvis height and leg/boot lengths constant. Hands/props retain original low carrying position, no extra hand. Small cloth/ponytail sway only. Lower legs must visibly exchange front/back ownership; DO NOT repeat same leading leg in frame3. Composition: four separate COMPLETE full-body figures in equal2x2 cells. Each figure occupies ONLY 70% of cell height with 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT border ABOVE hair, BELOW soles, and around all props. Generous margin especially ponytail/ahoge. Each has exactly2 arms/2 hands/2 legs. No cut-off body edges or touching cells. Refined broad soft-painted shading exactly matching reference. True transparent RGBA background; no shadow/floor, letters/numbers/gridlines, particles, props not in model, camera change, growth/shrink, alternate costume, labels or backdrop. Preserve anatomical accessory sides.
